slides.headline: 6 JOBS YOU'RE STILL PAYING FOR THAT FREE AI DOES
slides.image_prompt: Sam Altman holding OpenAI logo, minimal clean background, sharp face focus, confident expression, no text or clutter

caption:
6 free AI tools that do jobs most businesses pay $200 an hour for.

1) Build a pitch deck in seconds
Gamma.app, free. Type your idea, get a polished pitch deck. Designers charge $500 for this.
"Pitch deck for [business]. We [do what]. Target: [customer]."

2) Get a full competitor breakdown in 2 minutes
Perplexity.ai, free. Type a competitor, get pricing, weak spots, top complaints.
"Analyze [competitor]: pricing, weaknesses, top complaints."

3) Get notes and action items from every meeting
Otter.ai, free. Connect to Zoom. Every call gets a transcript and action items. Assistants charge $75/hr.
"Summarize this call and list action items with who owns each."

4) Turn a script into a real voice
ElevenLabs.io, free. Paste text, pick a voice, get clean audio. Voice actors charge $200 for 60 seconds.
"Hi, I'm [name], [business]. [Problem]? [Product] fixes it. Try free: [link]."

5) End a daily task forever
Make.com, free. Connect two apps. One trigger runs your workflow automatically. Developers charge $100/hr to build the same thing.
"Trigger: [form filled]. Action: add to Sheet, send: 'Got it, reply in 24 hrs.'"

6) Build a chatbot that knows your whole business
Chatbase.co, free. Feed it your FAQs or website. It handles every customer question 24/7. Hiring someone for this costs $2,400 a month.
"You are [business]'s assistant. Use only the uploaded files to answer questions. Be brief."

SAVE THIS, 6 free tools doing $200/hr work: Gamma (pitch decks) · Perplexity (competitor intel) · Otter (meeting notes) · ElevenLabs (voice) · Make (automation) · Chatbase (chatbot).

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Gamma Labs, Perplexity AI, Otter.ai, ElevenLabs, Make, Chatbase, Reuters
